page.content:
County town whose sheriff is Robin's standing enemy.

How Nottingham connects

  • Location: Nottingham Castle — Nottingham Castle is the crown fortress in the town.
  • Artist: Sheriff of Nottingham — The sheriff's power is the town and shire of Nottingham.
  • Event: Archery contest — The sheriff's archery contest is staged in Nottingham.
  • Work: Robin Hood and the Monk — The Monk ballad turns on Robin's capture in Nottingham.

What is Nottingham?

Nottingham is the urban pole of the legend: market, castle, and the sheriff's jurisdiction that the outlaws raid and mock.

Key threads lead to Nottingham Castle, Sheriff of Nottingham, Archery contest and Robin Hood and the Monk.
